## Progress

- [PR #53](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/53): `Money` (long minor units + ISO currency, checked, rates rounded half away from zero) in BuildingBlocks.Domain; new Billing module with DOC_SEQUENCE (`billing.DocSequences`) per tenant, country, doc type, financial year and prefix, incremented by MERGE WITH (HOLDLOCK) inside the issuing transaction; EF filter + RLS; `medvya_billing` role without DELETE
- Country rules: India `INV/25-26/00042` (April–March, max 16 characters), UAE `TI-AD-00042` (continuous series: the design carries no year); amount in words (lakh/crore, million) matches the design examples
- Tests on SQL Server 2022: 110 concurrent issues with 10 failing give exactly 1..100, rollback returns its number, FY rollover per prefix, cross-tenant blocked; no float/decimal in domain types or database columns; mutation-checked (unlocked increment, side-connection increment, RLS off, DELETE grant, rounding, overflow)
- Review fix (branch `fix/MDV-P4-001-P0-017-review`): trigger `TR_DocSequences_OnlyMoveForward` stops the app role's UPDATE from rewinding, skipping or moving a series (it was only denied DELETE); MERGE output goes INTO a table variable; Money operators throw ArgumentNullException on null
- Left: issuing invoices and per-facility prefix configuration (MDV-P4-004), cash rounding (MDV-P4-009/012), adviser review of formats (MDV-P4-031)

## Description

Money value object (bigint minor units + ISO currency), rounding rules per currency, amount-in-words (Indian lakh/thousand; AED). DOC_SEQUENCE per tenant, country, doc type (receipt, invoice, credit, advance), financial year (India Apr–Mar) and prefix, incremented gaplessly inside the issuing transaction.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** No floating-point money anywhere in domain/database (architecture test on property types).
- [ ] **AC2.** Concurrent issuing of 100 invoices produces 100 consecutive numbers with no gaps or duplicates (test).
- [ ] **AC3.** Financial-year rollover starts a new sequence per configured prefix.
- [ ] **AC4.** Amount in words matches the design examples for INR and AED.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
